description:
We recently visited Kuakata, a beautiful beach where you can see both the sunrise and sunset from the same spot – it was amazing! We traveled from Dhaka to Kuakata by bus and spent 2 nights and 3 days there. We explored the beach, enjoyed the views, and had a great time. Hope you enjoy the full adventure with us!
